title: Limits of schemes along affine transition morphisms
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then the limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ exists in the category of schemes; each projection $f_i:S\to S_i$ is affine; and for every $0\in I$ and every open subscheme $U_0\subseteq S_0$, $f_0^{-1}(U_0)=\varprojlim_{i\ge0}f_{i0}^{-1}(U_0)$ in the category of schemes (with the restricted projections), the transition morphisms $f_{i0}^{-1}(U_0)\to f_{i'0}^{-1}(U_0)$ being affine. If all $S_i$ are affine, $S=\operatorname{Spec}(\varinjlim_i\Gamma(S_i,\mathcal O_{S_i}))$ (Limits, Lemma 01YW).
